sections.label: Construction costs and Green Mark
sections.summary: Public procurement and CP2M norms ensure fair prices, while Green Mark Platinum buildings cost up to 5% more but save energy and water, paying back in three to six years.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: While consultancy and construction fees are driven by market forces, the public procurement frameworks ensure that agencies pay fair and competitive prices.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In addition, the Centre for Public Project Management (CP2M) compiles norms for construction costs and consultancy fees for agencies’ reference to aid in budgeting for projects.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: CP2M also works with agencies to review the design of major infrastructure projects to ensure cost effectiveness and value for money.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Based on a study conducted by the Building Construction Authority (BCA), buildings that meet the Green Mark Platinum standard cost up to 5% more compared to buildings that do not meet the required energy efficiency outcomes.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: However, the additional costs are more than offset by the savings from reduced energy and water consumption.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The payback period can range from three to six years, which is well within the typical useful life of the building asset.

sections.label: Green Mark health study and PSTLES
sections.summary: A BCA-NUS study found Green Mark buildings give healthier indoor environments, and PSTLES was launched in 2006 to improve public sector building efficiency.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Last September, BCA and the National University of Singapore (NUS) released the results of a joint research study which suggests that Green Mark buildings provide a healthier indoor environment for their occupants.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Occupants were also generally more satisfied with their indoor environment and were less likely to experience symptoms of Sick Building Syndrome.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: So, the initiative known as the Public Sector Taking the Lead in Environmental Sustainability (PSTLES) was launched in 2006 to improve energy and water efficiency of our public sector buildings and today we reaffirm that commitment.
